faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about OneSign

faq1.question: How long does it take to implement OneSign?
faq1.answer: Most organizations can complete basic implementation within 1-2 weeks. Our guided setup wizard and comprehensive documentation make the process straightforward. For enterprise deployments with complex requirements, our professional services team provides hands-on assistance.

faq2.question: Is OneSign compliant with industry regulations?
faq2.answer: Yes, OneSign is designed with compliance in mind. We support GDPR, SOC2 Type II, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS requirements out of the box. Our audit logging and reporting features make compliance verification simple.

faq3.question: Can OneSign integrate with our existing systems?
faq3.answer: Absolutely. OneSign integrates with 100+ enterprise applications including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, AWS, Azure, and more. We support SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and SCIM protocols for seamless integration.

faq4.question: What authentication methods does OneSign support?
faq4.answer: OneSign supports a wide range of authentication methods including passwords, TOTP authenticator apps, SMS and email OTP, push notifications, FIDO2 security keys, biometric authentication, and smart cards. You can configure different requirements based on user roles and risk levels.

faq5.question: How does OneSign handle data security?
faq5.answer: Security is our top priority. All data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). We use zero-knowledge architecture where possible, employ strict access controls, and undergo regular third-party security audits. Your data is hosted in SOC2 certified data centers.
